baseline_models.focus_anchor: The head predicate governs two parallel contrasts: concealed versus declared speech, then night-hidden versus day-traversing person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both binaries are placed in one access-equivalence class: changes in disclosure, illumination, and mobility do not change the person's availability to the implied knower.

activation_trace.role: Literal equalization supplies the invariant relation governing both paired contrasts.
Interior concealment supplies the low-visibility speech state.
Audible declaration supplies the public speech counterpart.
Self-concealment supplies the night-side bodily state.
Night darkness supplies the first temporal visibility regime.
Travel on an open route supplies the day-side bodily counterpart.
Daylight opening supplies the second temporal visibility regime.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists secret speech, loud speech, night hiding, and daytime movement.
changed_reading.after: It constructs one invariant of access across two different visibility systems, speech and bodily movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object remains 'saying' on both sides even when its first state is concealed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The concealed saying can be a formulation still inside the self, while declaration is its voiced state; the range therefore extends from cognition to public utterance, not merely from low to high volume.

activation_trace.role: Unvoiced saying supplies a genuinely interior starting state.
Concealment keeps that formulation from outward disclosure.
Articulated saying supplies the same content in emitted form.
Public voicing marks the exterior endpoint of the continuum.

changed_reading.before: Concealing the saying means uttering it quietly or privately.
changed_reading.after: The contrast may span pre-vocal inner speech through fully public voicing, with neither endpoint outside access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The night/day pair joins concealment to a root of route travel that also carries seepage, beside a day root that also carries river and opening images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The bodily pair can be modeled as two routes rather than motion versus stillness: hidden infiltration and open surface passage. Equality then holds across alternate pathways by which a person or signal moves.

activation_trace.role: Covertness supplies the below-visibility mode of passage.
Seepage supplies motion through a route that need not be openly visible.
A watercourse cutting ground supplies the contrasting open channel.
Widening until flow makes the daylight side a disclosed passage rather than mere illumination.
Equalization holds the infiltrating and open-channel modes together.

changed_reading.before: The night figure is hidden, whereas the day figure simply walks in public.
changed_reading.after: Both figures move through different transmission routes, one infiltrative and one opened, without either route escaping access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence turns hiddenness and manifestation into measurable states: changing embodied contents have a bounded measure, then unseen and witnessed domains are paired. The equality in 13:10 thus ranges over specified states, not only things that happen to be seen or heard.

activation_trace.role: Focus equalization provides the relation whose scope is sharpened by the preceding measures.
A bounded amount turns each changing thing into a specifiable state rather than a merely visible object.
Absence from sight supplies the hidden domain surrounding the focus contrast.
Presence under witnessing supplies the manifest domain paired with it.

structural_cues: 13:8 moves from concealed gestational change to exact measure, and 13:9 places unseen/witnessed immediately before 13:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quantified change and the unseen/witnessed pair; I infer that 13:10 applies their frame to speech and movement, while the live alternative is plain omniscience without a measurement model.

changed_reading.before: Hidden and visible acts are equally noticed.
changed_reading.after: Every inner, uttered, concealed, and mobile condition occupies the same measured state-space of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Alternating agents before and behind the person convert static observation into continuous handoff coverage. The night hider and day traveler are followed through transitions rather than caught only at exposed moments.

activation_trace.role: Route travel supplies the moving subject whose continuity needs explanation.
Succession supplies relay-like replacement around the moving person.
Alternation from behind supplies the rearward half of repeated coverage.
Guarding supplies the function maintained across those handoffs.

structural_cues: 13:11 immediately wraps one person with agents before and behind, then repeats internal and external change language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, front/back placement, and guarding; I infer a tracking relay across the focus person's mode changes, while a live alternative reads the agents as protection without surveillance implications.

changed_reading.before: One invariant observer directly sees both hidden and public states.
changed_reading.after: Access can be pictured operationally as uninterrupted relay coverage that persists while the person changes route, time, and visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Public emission is separated from response, arrival, and interior truth. A call can remain unanswered and fail to reach its target, while an overt saying can remain only an exterior layer; declaration therefore increases exposure without guaranteeing efficacy or transparency.

activation_trace.role: Raised public speech supplies emission but, by itself, no successful transfer.
Interior saying preserves a layer that outward emission need not exhaust.
Calling by speech supplies the emitted signal in the failed-transfer scene.
Verbal response supplies a distinct stage that emission does not compel.
Reaching a limit supplies delivery as a separate condition, explicitly not achieved.
The exterior-versus-interior image makes overt saying a surface layer rather than total disclosure.
Spoken saying anchors that exterior layer directly to the focus speech contrast.

structural_cues: 13:14 sequences call, nonresponse, hands extended to water, mouth, and failed arrival.
13:33 places an overt surface of saying inside a challenge about naming and claimed informing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct emission, response, reach, and exteriority stages; I align focus declaration with only the emission/surface stages, while the live alternative keeps the two later scenes rhetorically separate from 13:10.

changed_reading.before: Declared speech is fully disclosed and therefore communicatively effective.
changed_reading.after: Declared speech is exposed, but whether it reaches, receives response, or reveals the speaker's interior remains independent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same equality root is later put into two contrastive questions where blindness does not equal sight and darkness does not equal light. Focus equality is therefore scoped to accessibility before the knower, not generalized into sameness of capacity, truth, or value.

activation_trace.role: Focus equality initially appears broad enough to risk flattening its contrasted states.
Repeated comparison supplies a controlled later test in which equality is rhetorically denied.
Loss of sight supplies a capacity difference that access-equivalence does not erase.
Actual seeing supplies the unequal perceptual counterpart.
Illumination supplies the positive pole of the second denied equivalence.

structural_cues: 13:16 repeats the focus equality root in parallel rhetorical questions: blind/sighted and darkness/light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one affirmed equality and two later denied equalities; I infer a change of comparison axis, with access equal in 13:10 but capacities and values unequal in 13:16. A live alternative treats each occurrence as locally unrelated rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: Secret/open and night/day may be flattened into undifferentiated sameness.
changed_reading.after: They remain genuinely different states; only their accessibility to the knower is equalized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's infiltrating and open-channel branch images become a material assay in 13:17: flow is apportioned through channels, conspicuous foam rises and is cast away, while useful content remains. Visibility and volume no longer predict persistence or truth.

activation_trace.role: Seepage supplies the focus-side hidden flow that the later torrent can activate.
A channel cut by running water supplies the focus-side open route.
Torrent flow supplies the force carrying both durable content and visible excess.
A flood channel supplies capacity-specific routing rather than undifferentiated movement.
Floating froth supplies highly visible output that is not thereby durable.
Discarded material supplies removal of the conspicuous surface product.
Remaining in place supplies persistence as a criterion distinct from publicity.

structural_cues: 13:17 orders descent, channels by capacity, carried foam, casting away, and useful remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a flow-and-sorting sequence; I map focus speech and movement onto its routing distinction, while the live alternative confines the analogy to truth and falsehood without applying it to secret/public transmission.

changed_reading.before: Open declaration is the fuller or more consequential form of speech.
changed_reading.after: Secret and public speech are different flow surfaces; the loudest visible layer may vanish while less conspicuous content persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed/public polarity reappears around resource transfer, turning the focus pair from passive visibility states into complementary modes of deliberate action. Equal observability does not erase their different social operation.

activation_trace.role: Concealed speech supplies the focus's private channel.
Public speech supplies the focus's openly legible channel.
Money going outward supplies substantive transfer through both channels.
Secret action reuses the focus concealment root as an intentional practice mode.
Manifest action supplies the deliberate public counterpart to that mode.

structural_cues: 13:22 coordinates secret/public spending as one practice, then uses branchless د ر ء only structurally for active countering of harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one resource act performed secretly and publicly; I infer that 13:10's speech pair can also mark operational channels, while the live alternative limits the reuse to spending vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: Secret and public are merely conditions under which speech is observed.
changed_reading.after: They can be intentionally selected channels for consequential action, different in social effect even when equally known.

context_deltas.mechanism: A commissioned message is secretly conveyed, then followed and recited publicly. Concealment and declaration can therefore be serial phases of one communication pipeline rather than rival kinds of speaker.

activation_trace.role: Unvoiced saying supplies the focus's latent message state.
Public voicing supplies the pipeline's manifest output state.
Knowledge imparted covertly supplies a hidden but information-rich input.
Following in sequence supplies the transition from received input to recitation.
Messenger and message supply the public commission that carries the hidden input outward.

structural_cues: 13:30 places sending, recitation, and secretly conveyed content in one directed sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden impartation followed by commissioned recitation; I infer a temporal pipeline between focus concealment and declaration, while a live alternative keeps the focus clauses as separate persons rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: The one who conceals and the one who declares represent mutually exclusive speaker types.
changed_reading.after: Concealed and declared saying may also be successive states of the same message moving from hidden reception to public recitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a spatial branch from a different form of the same root into the focus predicate. It remains anchored by the repeated root and the focus's moving subjects, but downstream prose should present it only as a reference-frame analogy, never as a replacement translation for the equality term.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The equality predicate stands over paired speakers and movers whose conditions change beneath it.

activation_trace.role: Equality supplies the invariant that needs a stable comparison frame.
Rising and settling on something supplies an elevated stable reference position.
The raised royal seat supplies the spatial support for that fixed position.
Continuous running supplies changing objects measured from the stable frame.

changed_reading.before: Equality is an abstract claim that hidden and public states are alike in one respect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is viewpoint invariance: changing speech and motion remain equally exposed from a stable elevated frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates disputed or form-distant senses inside the very roots assigned to concealment and visibility. The reading remains focus-anchored, but it should be rendered as lexical pressure that destabilizes a clean binary, not as the primary meaning of any focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Several roots on the hidden/open axis contain branch senses that point across the axis rather than staying on their expected side.

activation_trace.role: The disputed disclosure sense inside the concealment root makes the first pole semantically reversible.
Removal of hiddenness lets the self-concealing root also carry emergence.
An eye overwhelmed by sunlight makes extreme visibility capable of defeating sight.
Day opening intensifies the exposure that can cease to be informative.

changed_reading.before: Concealed and declared states form a clean one-way scale from invisible to visible.
changed_reading.after: The roots fold across that scale: concealment can disclose, and maximal exposure can impair seeing, so the poles are operationally unstable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation because it treats a shadow as derivative evidence about the focus traveler. It remains anchored to the night/day body and the immediately nearby temporal sequence, but downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of involuntary trace rather than claim that 13:10 explicitly names shadows.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The day traveler can control speech and route but not every sign generated by bodily presence.

activation_trace.role: Open-route travel supplies the moving body that generates derivative signs.
A cast shadow supplies an involuntary secondary trace of the standing or moving body.
Morning departure extends that trace into active daytime movement.
Late-day time extends the trace across the visible day's changing angles.
Compliance supplies the shadow's alignment with an order beyond the person's chosen disclosure.
Compulsion supplies the involuntary side of that generated testimony.

changed_reading.before: A person manages visibility by hiding at night or moving openly by day.
changed_reading.after: The body emits derivative traces such as shadow that testify across the day regardless of chosen secrecy or publicity.

strongest_changes: Equality became access-relative and explicitly bounded: it preserves differences in capacity, truth, and value.
Static omniscience acquired operational models of exact measure and relay coverage across changing states.
Speech became a routed process in which publicity differs from delivery, response, interior truth, and persistence.
Secret/public states also became complementary action channels and successive hidden-input/public-output stages.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported both ordinary binaries and live counter-images: inner saying, seepage, opened channels, disclosure inside concealment, and overexposure. Ordered context then supplied measurement, relays, failed transfer, denied equalities, material sorting, dual-channel practice, and covert-to-public transmission without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The flow model depends on form-distant water senses of the day and route roots and should remain analogical.
The elevated reference frame and visibility reversal are rooted but should not displace the primary lexical readings.
The packet does not decide whether concealed saying is pre-vocal thought, privately uttered speech, or both; both readings remain live.
